build_question_answering_evaluator: build a question-answering evaluator to evaluate extractive QA models on datasets like SQuAD
run_compute_squad: run compute on the QuestionAnsweringEvaluator to evaluate a model on SQuAD dataset with squad metric
run_compute_squad_v2: run compute on the QuestionAnsweringEvaluator to evaluate a model on SQuAD v2 dataset with no-answer support
test_prepare_data: test the prepare_data method to validate dataset columns and extract references and pipeline inputs
test_predictions_processor: test the predictions_processor method to format model predictions for squad v1 or squad v2 metrics
